name: b10-0.1.6
description:
Binds the proven B10 release scripts (candidate 0.1.6 = b3b1009, derived baseline 0.1.3) to the canonical phases. The scripts live in the ignored target/ recovery folders and are sha256-pinned here; several of them hard-code 0.1.6/B10, so this kit binds exactly that release. B10 phases that already ran outside the orchestrator are recorded with `run --execute --adopt --phase

`.

steps.note: Prints only the expiry; the token stays in the Azure CLI store. A failure means the owner runs az login.
run: az account get-access-token --resource https://codesigning.azure.net --query expiresOn -o tsv

steps.note: Creates baseline (derive-baseline-013), T, N0, W, LW, LM branches in new worktrees; never pushes. Refuses if any exists.
W and N0 were re-pinned after the B10 branch review (TOOLING-REPIN.md section 7); the reviewed commits are kit vars.
build-windows.mjs (Authenticode via Azure Artifact Signing + updater Minisign) and verify-windows.mjs; exit 10 = signed, clean-machine verify deferred to verify-windows.

steps.operator: Run `node tooling/release/verify-windows.mjs` for both installers on a clean Windows state: the private CI runner (.github/workflows/windows-release-verify.yml, draft-release inputs as in docs/RELEASING.md section 2), a VM, or a disposable data root with the owner's install set aside. Attest both verify.json files.

steps.note: Requires refs/heads/main == the candidate commit (the Mac has no GitHub credentials; commits travel as verified bundles).
Bootstraps the launchd package job into the owner's GUI session (login keychain: Developer ID + KalCode-release notary profile). The Mac must be logged in at the console.

steps.operator: Run P0-P8 of target/recovery-B10-mac-prep/MAC-B10-POST-PACKAGE.md for the candidate and the baseline profile: harvest + transfer equality, retain-notary capture, the Mac updater signature on Windows (target/recovery-B10-release/sign-mac-updater-b3b1009.mjs), fresh verifier, remote certification, assemble-certification (24/24). These are still hand-run shell snippets in B10; the check step below gates on their results.

steps.check: certified Mac packets for the candidate and the baseline

steps.operator: Fill the Windows (LW) and Mac (LM) lifecycle collectors with `fill-b10-pins.mjs collectors --worktree ...` (TOOLING-REPIN.md section 4, steps 2-3) and write the Mac candidate-pin.json. The EXE/guardian/bundle-tree values come from the certification records; this is the one pin fill not yet derived automatically in B10.

qa-sittings.instructions: Run the B10 sittings (target/recovery-B10/B10-PLAN.md section 4, S1-S3) on a disposable data root / clean-state aside on the main account (no extra Windows accounts): clean install + launch, provider sign-ins (OAuth/2FA), KalVoice microphone, physical sleep/wake, Mac GUI rows. Attest once the evidence roots are sealed with their SHA256SUMS.

steps.operator: Bind the sealed sittings into the four records with target/recovery-B10/filler/fill-b10-records.mjs (set / BASE-CITE / finalize) and place them as windows-x86_64-qa.json and macos-arm64-qa.json in both staging directories. The validate step below re-checks all four with the byte-pinned T validator.

steps.check: the filled publish pins; later phases refuse if they change

lifecycle.instructions: B10-PLAN.md section 5 on Windows and Mac against the unlisted staged descriptors: LC-A (installer over the previous install, data preserved) and LC-B (baseline 0.1.3 -> in-app update 0.1.6 -> Restore -> reupdate). Attest with the two lifecycle receipts.

release-review.instructions: An independent reviewer (not the operator) reviews the final QA records, notes and receipts and writes a review file ending in PASS.

steps.note: First D1 cutover (flag still false): the one-time bootstrap-authority pointer. Later releases replace this step with the normal publisher.

website-merge.instructions: Push release/website-{version}-{commit7}, open the PR (never push to main), get the independent review of the assembled commit, merge. Attest with the review receipt and a JSON file {"mergedCommit": "<origin/main sha40>"}.

live-human.instructions: B10-PLAN.md S5: download from kalcoded.com on a clean state (disposable data root / VM), install, launch, confirm 0.1.6 and that the updater offers nothing newer. Attest with the LV evidence file.
